title: SkyTruth Cerulean — near-real-time global oil slick detection
snippet: SkyTruth's Cerulean ML model scans Sentinel-1 SAR daily for oil slicks; updated for near-real-time detection within hours of capture. Integrated into Skylight platform for marine monitoring; correlates with AIS vessel data to identify likely polluters. Used in 2026 to expose Russia's shadow fleet.
